summary.purpose: Extract a detailed, filtered list of Commercial Package policies for the Agribusiness profit center, including transaction type indicators and premium amounts, for a specified policy period and job close date range.
summary.high_level_narrative: The script declares four date variables and sets a policy start, end, and change start date. It then runs a UNION ALL of two SELECT statements that pull policy period records from the PolicyCenter database. Each SELECT joins many reference tables (policy, term, job, account, producer, organization, profit center, UW company, job description, etc.) to enrich the data. For Commercial Package policies the script calculates the written premium by summing amounts from the appropriate transaction table based on the line‑of‑business pattern code; otherwise it uses the pre‑calculated TransactionCostRPT field. Additional CASE expressions create columns that expose values only for specific transaction types (Renewal, Submission, Cancellation, Reinstatement, PolicyChange). After the UNION, an outer SELECT filters rows where the policy period start or the job close date falls between the supplied start and end dates, excludes the generic C.P.P. line, and limits results to the Agribusiness profit center. The final result set is ordered by policy number and is intended for reporting or downstream analysis.
outputs: Result set with columns: ProfitCenter, ProductCode, LineOfBusiness, PolicyNumber, OriginalEffectiveDate, PeriodStart, PeriodEnd, AccountNumber, Company, PrimaryInsuredName, AgentCode, AgentName, FarmUWTerritory, MostRecentTran, SubWritten_Premium, SubWritten_Date, CancelledDate, CancelledEffDate, CancelledPremium, ReinstatedPremium, ReinstatedDate, ReinstatedEffDate, ChangePremium, ChangeDate

Conditional CASE columns that expose premium, dates, and effective dates only for specific transaction types (Renewal, Submission, Cancellation, Reinstatement, PolicyChange).
Union of two queries: first with detailed line‑of‑business mapping, second providing a fallback for C.P.P. line.
Filtering rows where PeriodStart or JobCloseDate falls within @POLSTARTDATE‑@POLENDDATE, ProductCode = 'CommercialPackage', LineOfBusiness not equal to 'C.P.P.', and ProfitCenter = 'Agribusiness'.

knowledge_profile.purpose: Generate a consolidated view of policy periods for the Agribusiness profit center, focusing on CommercialPackage policies within a defined policy year. The query classifies transactions (renewal, cancellation, reinstatement, change) into derived premium and date columns, applies status and date filters, and calculates written premiums using transaction‑level sums when applicable.

inputs: Transaction tables pcx_cp7transaction, pcx_gl7transaction_gle, pcx_ca7transaction, pcx_cr7transaction, pc_imtransaction, pcx_wc7transaction
outputs: Result set with columns: ProfitCenter, ProductCode, LineOfBusiness, PolicyNumber, OriginalEffectiveDate, PeriodStart, PeriodEnd, AccountNumber, Company, PrimaryInsuredName, AgentCode, AgentName, FarmUWTerritory, MostRecentTran, SubWritten_Premium, SubWritten_Date, CancelledDate, CancelledEffDate, CancelledPremium, ReinstatedPremium, ReinstatedDate, ReinstatedEffDate, ChangePremium, ChangeDate

key_logic: Declare and set four date/period variables.
Select from a UNION of two sub‑queries that pull policy period rows.
First sub‑query joins many reference tables to enrich the policy period with profit center, agent, territory, company, and transaction data.
Derived columns are created using CASE expressions that depend on TranType, ProductCode, and PatternCode.

When ProductCode = 'CommercialPackage' the Written_Premium is calculated by summing the Amount column from the appropriate transaction table based on PatternCode; otherwise the pre‑calculated TransactionCostRPT is used.
Second sub‑query handles rows where the policy line of business is not derived from PatternCode (hard‑coded 'C.P.P.').

Both sub‑queries are filtered by issue date, policy number presence, status (Bound or AuditComplete), close date before @POLENDDATE, and additional business rules on dates, product code, line of business, and profit center.
Final outer SELECT applies additional CASE derivations and filters on the combined result set, then orders by PolicyNumber.

transformations.description: Calculate Written_Premium for CommercialPackage policies by summing Amount from the appropriate transaction table based on PatternCode; otherwise use TransactionCostRPT.
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN ProductCode = 'CommercialPackage' THEN CASE WHEN PatternCode = 'cp7line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_cp7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN PatternCode = 'GeneralLiabilityLine_GLE' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_gl7transaction_gle tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN PatternCode = 'ca7line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_ca7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN PatternCode = 'cr7line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_cr7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN PatternCode = 'imline' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pc_imtransaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) WHEN PatternCode = 'WC7Line' THEN (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(amount),0) FROM pcx_wc7transaction tr WHERE tr.BranchID = pp.id) END ELSE TransactionCostRPT END
